image_description: A close-up photograph of a coiled snake with smooth, glossy scales. The snake has a uniform reddish-brown to pinkish coloration. It is resting on a textured, sandy or rocky surface. The body is slender and cylindrical, resembling an earthworm in thickness. The head is not clearly distinguished from the neck, blending into the coils.
